# BoxAI Documentation

> Unified AI API gateway at https://you-box.com

## Core pages

- [What is BoxAI](https://you-box.com/docs/start/what-is-boxai): BoxAI (you-box.com) is a unified AI API gateway for multi-provider models, billing, and developer access — Vietnam first, other overseas markets second.
- [Getting started](https://you-box.com/docs/start/getting-started): Create an API key, choose a model, and send your first gateway request on you-box.com.
- [First request](https://you-box.com/docs/start/first-request): Send a successful chat completion from Playground or curl, then confirm usage.
- [Create and manage API keys](https://you-box.com/docs/console/api-keys): Issue a key, set limits, copy the secret once, and use it only from trusted servers.
- [Model Hub](https://you-box.com/docs/console/model-hub): Find exact model IDs, compare pricing and capabilities, then use those IDs in API calls.
- [Billing and top-up](https://you-box.com/docs/console/billing-topup): Understand balance, top up with supported payment rails (including Vietnam-first options), and keep usage within quota.
- [Usage logs](https://you-box.com/docs/console/usage-logs): Read request history, tokens, and status codes to debug billing and integration issues.
- [API overview](https://you-box.com/docs/api/overview): One gateway base URL, multiple protocol profiles, and model IDs from Model Hub.
- [API authentication](https://you-box.com/docs/api/auth): Authenticate gateway calls with Bearer keys or profile-specific headers and keep secrets server-side.
- [Streaming](https://you-box.com/docs/api/streaming): Process incremental server-sent events and cancel interrupted requests safely.
- [Errors, retries, and rate limits](https://you-box.com/docs/api/errors): Classify failures, retry transient requests safely, and respect gateway limits.
- [Get started with BoxAI Desktop](https://you-box.com/docs/clients/desktop): Install the desktop agent, sign in to BoxAI, and work safely with projects, models and tools.
- [Install and open BoxAI Desktop](https://you-box.com/docs/clients/desktop/install): Download the right installer and handle first-open security warnings safely on macOS and Windows.
- [Sign in to BoxAI Desktop](https://you-box.com/docs/clients/desktop/sign-in): Authorize the desktop app with your BoxAI account and keep account access private.
- [Choose a Desktop model and understand billing](https://you-box.com/docs/clients/desktop/models-and-billing): Select an available BoxAI model, run a small test and check authoritative usage on the website.
- [Work with projects and sessions](https://you-box.com/docs/clients/desktop/projects-and-sessions): Open a folder, give the agent a bounded task and review results without losing track of your work.
- [Review tool permissions](https://you-box.com/docs/clients/desktop/tool-approvals): Understand Ask, Accept edits and Auto before allowing file changes, commands or external tools.
- [Add skills, plugins and MCP tools](https://you-box.com/docs/clients/desktop/extensions): Extend Desktop carefully, choose global or project scope and verify each capability before relying on it.
- [Update BoxAI Desktop](https://you-box.com/docs/clients/desktop/updates): Check the current release, install an official update and preserve your projects and local data.
- [Troubleshoot BoxAI Desktop](https://you-box.com/docs/clients/desktop/troubleshooting): Find safe fixes for startup, authorization, model access and tools, and prepare a useful support report.
- [Codex desktop with a custom BoxAI API](https://you-box.com/docs/clients/codex-desktop): Configure the current Codex desktop client with config.toml and auth.json, use BoxAI Responses models, and verify which provider is billed.
- [BoxAI Connect](https://you-box.com/docs/clients/connect): Connect your local coding agents to BoxAI through a desktop gateway.
- [Install BoxAI Connect](https://you-box.com/docs/clients/connect/install): Install the macOS Apple silicon or Windows x64 release safely.
- [Sign in to BoxAI Connect](https://you-box.com/docs/clients/connect/sign-in): Authorize Connect in your browser and understand where its API key is stored.
- [Agents, models and Library](https://you-box.com/docs/clients/connect/agents-and-models): Choose conversational BoxAI models for your installed agents and use Library carefully.
- [Gateway and Routing](https://you-box.com/docs/clients/connect/gateway-and-routing): Use Connect's local connection details and inspect requests without exposing your cloud key.
- [Account, usage and troubleshooting](https://you-box.com/docs/clients/connect/account-and-troubleshooting): Understand account-wide usage, manage authorization and recover safely from common Connect problems.
- [Playground overview](https://you-box.com/docs/playground/overview): Try models in the browser, validate prompts, and prepare for API integration.
- [Models, groups, and quota](https://you-box.com/docs/concepts/models-groups-quota): How model IDs, access groups, and remaining quota work together on BoxAI.
